title: Locked chests and keys: per-chest locks, locked Gold Chests in the dungeon, Shadow Chests in the underworld, unopened chests keep their loot
player_outcome: Dungeon Gold Chests are locked; each Golden Key opens one. One of them holds the Shadow Key, which opens (and is kept for) the locked Shadow Chests in the underworld's ruins. Locked chests cannot be smashed, and breaking an unopened chest no longer destroys its loot.
design: TileObjectDef: Lock { Key (item id), Consume = true, RequiresFlag (string?), Message (string?) }.
TileObjectInstance.Locked (bool). ChunkCodec WriteObjects/ReadObjects state byte bit 2 (value 4) = Locked, so the format is unchanged.
ObjectOp gains Locked, and Blueprint.Object gets a locked: overload. FeatureCarver.Stamp copies it to the instance.
A RequiresFlag that is not set → Refused(Message ?? 'It's locked.').
Otherwise TakeKey (when Consume) or HasKey → Locked=false, MarkModified, a new Unlocked event, then open.
WorldEditor.HitObject: a new ObjectHitResult.Locked when obj.Locked. Call EnsureContainerLoot(obj) before the NotEmpty check so unrolled world chests keep their loot (this fixes a loot-loss bug).
gold_chest gets lock {key golden_key}. It only applies to Locked instances.
New object shadow_chest: model from the chest generator with dark wood, obsidian bands and a purple latch; lock {key shadow_key, consume false}.
DungeonDecorator (P4-19) marks treasure-room chests Locked with loot dungeon_chest, and the ShadowKey spot with dungeon_chest_shadow_key.

UnderworldPass.cs:53 places shadow_chest, Locked, loot 'shadow_chest'. New table 'shadow_chest': sunfury, dark_lance, flamelash (weighted; moved out of cabin_chest_primary), plus hellstone bars and potions.
SFX: 'unlock' (click and jingle) and 'locked' (dull clack) via sfx_recipes. SoundEvents subscribes to ObjectInteraction.Unlocked and Refused.
Command 'interact nearest <objectId> [radius]' in src/Strata.Core/Commands/EditCommands.cs, for smoke tests.
Re-pin golden hashes: underworld chests change.
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Interaction/WorldEditor.Objects.cs — Locked result, roll loot before NotEmpty
data_changes: gold_chest lock, shadow_chest object and table, underworld loot moved.
tests: Smoke dungeon.cmds: 'flag defeated_skeletron', 'tp landmark dungeon_chest', 'wait_until stream.idle == 1 600', 'interact nearest gold_chest 8' (refused), 'give golden_key 1', 'interact nearest gold_chest 8', 'assert inv.golden_key == 0'.
verification: dotnet test; validate; headless dungeon.cmds prints SMOKE PASS
risks: The ChunkCodec bit is backward compatible (old saves read 0), though old worlds are disposable anyway.
The NPC/UI phases may also touch the chest UI (quick stack, rename). No overlap with lock logic.
